caption: Type f
note: f waits for a letter, and the status line shows it.

caption: Type c
note: The cursor goes to the next c on the line.

caption: Press ; then ,
note: ; repeats the find forward, and , goes back the other way.

caption: Type 3fc
note: Only one c is left after the cursor, so the find fails and the cursor stays.

caption: Type t then x
note: t stops on the letter before the next x.

caption: Type F then a
note: F goes back to the a before the cursor.

caption: Type f then Esc, then x
note: Esc cancels f. The cursor stays, and x then deletes the letter under it.

caption: Press 0, then type dtx
note: d with t deletes up to the letter before the x.

caption: Press j, 0, then type df.
note: d with f deletes through the dot it finds.

caption: Press .
note: . repeats the delete with its own letter.

caption: Press u, u, then type dfz
note: No z on the line: the find fails, and d deletes nothing.

caption: Press v, then type f.
note: In VISUAL the find moves the cursor end and the selection grows to the dot.

caption: Press ;
note: ; finds the next dot, and the selection grows again.
